verdict: Lead costs rose sharply this week; audience refresh is already underway.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 99 leads at an average cost of $7.46 per lead, but the past 7 days showed a real drop — leads fell 44.83% and cost per lead rose 82.85% on nearly unchanged spend. The most likely cause is audience exhaustion in the retargeting campaign that carried half the 28-day budget; the same pool of people has been served ads long enough that response has declined. Ad creative and audience targeting are being refreshed this week to reverse the efficiency loss. Google Business Profile activity also dipped sharply over the last several days, and that is being monitored alongside the paid work to make sure organic interest stabilises.
